reviews.text:
Needed to get an ultrasound of my dog's liver for elevated liver enzymes called and tried to get an appointment but couldn't get one for several weeks, so I went through the ER. Waited 2 1/2 hours before anyone saw us, even though I was told to go to the ER to get the ultrasound done. After waiting for 2 1/2 hours, they did finally call and contact the ultrasound technician who did come to the clinic that the same day, which was nice but I still there for six hours. If they would've called the tech that same day when we got there, or just scheduled the ultrasound over the phone, then I wouldn't have had to sit there the whole time with my dog. Then she had a  liver biopsy done. Had to wait for the surgeon to call me with the results, but he wasn't able to really tell me anything about the results, just read them to me, so why couldn't they just tell me them over the phone? I then had to schedule an appointment with the internal medicine vet and that's gonna be another three weeks. I hope my dog doesn't die in  the meantime.

Based on the above review they kicked me out of the practice. After spending over $4000. Do not take your pet to this practice. She had surgery 1 week ago, so a complication could still occur.

I was referred to Arista by another vet hospital in the Garland area, and they came highly recommended especially for cardiac patients. I was overwhelmed and just trying to find someplace that could nail down what was making my Stevie so sick.

From the moment I walked through the doors I was impressed. The facility is beautiful, and the staff was organized, competent, and engaged through the entire experience. I truly felt like my baby was getting top notch care.

What stood out even more is that they weren't just focused on my dog. They were wonderful to me too, patiently addressing every concern I had. Five stars, easily earned.

So thankful and grateful for the care we received for my dog Dixie from doctor and the rest of the team. The doctors were very knowledgeable and compassionate and I felt like my dog was in very good hands. Thank you again for the positive experience during such a scary and stressful time!

I want to start this review by saying that while I haven’t had the opportunity to work with every doctor at Arista, there are so many people here who I have become incredibly grateful for. Navigating my Sphynx cat Saint’s HCM/CHF diagnosis has easily been one of the hardest and scariest experiences of my life, and I genuinely don’t know what I would have done without the cardiology team here.

I am especially and forever grateful for Dr. Fauske, Dr. Peoples, Jamila, and Demi, who have each played such an important role in his care. Through emergency visits, difficult nights & days, countless questions, and all of the ups and downs that come with a disease like this, they have not only taken incredible care of my boy, but have shown me so much patience, empathy, and compassion along the way.

Loving an animal with a serious and unpredictable condition comes with so much fear, and at times it can feel incredibly lonely trying to make the right decisions for someone who means everything to you. But even during some of our hardest moments, I have never felt like I was simply being handed information and left to figure it out on my own. This team has always made me feel like they are in it with us. They listen, they answer my questions, they take my concerns seriously, and above all, I have always felt that they genuinely care.

I feel incredibly fortunate to be able to say that Saint is still here with me today, and I will never take for granted the role this team has played in giving us more time together. There really aren’t enough words to express what that means to me.

I could not recommend Arista more and I will forever be grateful for everything this team has done, and continues to do, for us. 🤍

This was one of the best veterinary experiences I have had in over 10 years as a pet owner. My French bulldog came in with labored breathing late at night and they swiftly took her back to assess her. Throughout my time there, Vet Tech Emily and Dr. Peoples were incredibly kind and answered all of my questions with patience and compassion. We were able to get a diagnosis and they gave me a detailed outpatient plan covering everything from what to look for in case she gets worse to medication to feeding recommendations. I would highly recommend Arista Dallas to anyone needing emergent veterinary care!

It can be incredibly difficult to find a veterinary hospital you truly trust, and I am so grateful I found this one. One of the things that impresses me most is that they always follow up the next day just to make sure everything is okay. That kind of personal attention means so much to me.

Titan has been going through severe heart failure, so finding people I trust with his care is extremely important. I have never felt that they have used his illness as an opportunity to recommend unnecessary treatments or take advantage of me financially—something I unfortunately have experienced elsewhere.

His cardiologist, Dr. Fauske, has been incredible. She sits in the room with me, talks to me like a human being, and gives me all the time I need to ask questions. I never feel rushed, and she makes sure I understand exactly what is happening with Titan and his care.

Now let me talk about the rest of the gang. Every single person who works there is personable, caring, and helpful. They have a way of making us feel like we are the only people there.

Most importantly, I know Titan is genuinely cared for and loved when he is there. Having Dr. Fauske and a veterinary team I can trust during such a difficult time gives me tremendous peace of mind.

I am so thankful to have found them and highly, highly recommend this veterinary hospital. ❤️🐾

I am extremely pleased with our experience at Arista.

On Monday night, our dog, Frankie, suffered a rather large cut underneath her eye. We took her to an after-hours clinic and spent three hours there, only to be turned away and told that we would need to return the following morning for the laceration repair. We felt very dismissed by their lack of concern regarding Frankie’s injury and pain level, and we were not comfortable waiting until the next day to have her treated.

We asked if there was a 24-hour veterinary hospital nearby and were referred to Arista. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted by a very friendly staff member who helped us with the paperwork and got us into an exam room right away.

Dr. Gilson came in shortly afterward to examine Frankie. She clearly explained what the repair would involve, what to expect with her care afterward, and the associated cost. We immediately felt that Frankie was in good hands and that her comfort and well-being were truly a priority.

We are incredibly grateful for the compassionate, professional, and timely care Frankie received at Arista. The entire team made a stressful situation much easier for us, and we would not hesitate to recommend Arista to other pet owners.

We came to Arista unexpectedly when our beloved 10-year old blue healer having been diagnosed hours before with a mass and fluid around her heart, having difficulty with breathing and very lethargic. We were referred to Arista because they provide emergency veterinary care 24 hours a day and have a cardiology specialist available.

From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly kind, compassionate, and attentive. They did everything they could to help save our sweet Julie. The veterinarians took the time to sit with us, explain what was happening with her, and carefully walk us through the different options available so we could make the best decisions possible for her care.

One thing that especially touched us was that every staff member who came into the room already knew about Julie and what was happening with her. We never felt like we had to repeatedly explain our situation. Everyone treated Julie as though she mattered to them, too.

When we ultimately had to make the heartbreaking decision to let Julie go, they gave us a beautiful, peaceful room where we could spend as much time with her as we needed and say our final goodbyes. It felt warm and comfortable, almost like being at home rather than in a veterinary hospital. That meant more to us than I can put into words during such a difficult moment.

The veterinary technicians were also incredibly thoughtful. We could not bear to make Julie’s paw print in a stone kit my daughter brought in, so they took their time and did it for us. They also made a beautiful ink print of her paw and her nose so we would have those precious keepsakes to remember her by.

Needless to say, the entire Arista staff, from the receptionists and laboratory technicians to the veterinary technicians and veterinarians, were absolutely amazing. Losing Julie was heartbreaking, but the kindness, compassion, dignity, and respect they showed both Julie and our family made an incredibly painful experience a little easier to bear.

We will forever be grateful for the care they gave our sweet Julie during her final hours and for the compassion they showed us as her family. I cannot recommend Arista highly enough, especially to anyone facing an emergency or one of the most difficult moments a pet parent can experience.

We brought our beagle here after she had a very poor reaction to the flu vaccine at our normal vet. Every part of our visit was excellent. Everyone we encountered was helpful and kind. Dr Eric Shuffelbottom was absolutely terrific! I wish they weren’t just emergency care because if they did routine vet care we would switch to them in a heartbeat!

Dr. Adamson and the entire veterinary hospital team provided exceptional care and truly went above and beyond for our dog Lyla. They were compassionate, attentive, and genuinely caring throughout the experience. I highly recommend Dr. Adamson and Arista to anyone looking for a team they can trust with their pets!

What a wonderful place ! The vet was amazing and the staff took such good care of my bulldog. Iris was lovely  she was so sweet to us.  ! She handled everything perfectly , kept me updated , answer all calls , managed pricing , and took great care of my baby. My dog made it through the surgery safely thanks to them.
Thank you for your 5-star review!

I can't begin to say enough nice things about Arista & all of their staff.
They saved my fur baby Bentley he had multiple stones in his bladder which moved into his urethra.
The stones tore a hole in his bladder.
He required emergency surgery Wed. 8/5.
This is absolutely the best place to take your fur babies.

I took our senior dog in yesterday due to diarrhea, loss of appetite and suspected dehydration.  I was greeted immediately by a very pleasant young man at the desk and soon seen by vet assistance  was thorough in taking information to relay to vet. Dr. Eric. Shufflebottom who  came to discuss and make a plan.  All went well and they took care if Maverick and spent so much time going  over every detail of his exam, bloodwork, plan moving forward and additional a supportive advice.  I  cannot say enough to express our appreciation for their professional and kind  attention all the 4 hours we were there.
This is our second visit to Arista and I highly recommend them. .

I took my dog, Charlie, to Arista Advanced Pet Care in Dallas on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, at approximately 8:30 p.m., after he had been attacked by a pit bull about an hour earlier. Charlie had two puncture wounds on his upper thigh and hind leg that were bleeding continuously.

When we first arrived, the front desk staff was courteous and efficient. Unfortunately, after Charlie was taken to the treatment area, our experience changed dramatically.

We waited more than 45 minutes before receiving any meaningful update. During that time, a veterinary technician told us that Charlie's injuries appeared to be superficial and that the veterinarian would see him soon. After waiting approximately an hour and a half, the veterinarian told us that Charlie had a "rolling bite" injury and believed the skin had shifted from its original location. She expressed concern that the bite may have actually been in his abdomen rather than his hind leg and discussed the possibility of fluid in his abdomen. She strongly recommended immediate exploratory surgery, said she would need to call in a surgeon, and estimated the cost at approximately $8,000.

When we said we wanted to take Charlie elsewhere for another opinion, we were strongly discouraged and told that delaying surgery could cost him his life. Throughout the visit, I was never allowed to go back and see my dog, nor did the veterinarian personally show me or clearly explain the injuries she was describing. Instead of feeling informed, I felt frightened, pressured, and left with many unanswered questions.

We decided to seek a second opinion at another veterinary clinic just five minutes away. The veterinarian there examined Charlie, determined that he had two puncture bite wounds, prescribed pain medication and antibiotics, and told us he should recover within a few days without emergency exploratory surgery. Charlie recovered as expected.

This experience was extremely upsetting. What began as an emergency turned into a situation where we received vastly different medical opinions within minutes of each other. I understand that veterinarians can have differing professional judgments, but I believe pet owners deserve timely communication, transparency, and the opportunity to understand their pet's condition before being asked to make a costly and life-changing decision.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend Arista Advanced Pet Care. While the front desk staff was professional and kind, I was disappointed by the communication, the lengthy wait, the inability to see my dog during the examination, and the way such a serious recommendation was presented.

I have taken some time to write this review because after everything our dog Bubbles and our family went through, I wanted to make sure I could truly put into words how grateful we are to Arista.

Bubbles had her surgery back in April, and I wanted to share our experience. For almost two years, we struggled with not knowing what was going on with our girl. She was sick on and off, and we were constantly trying to find answers and figure out how to help her feel better.

Bubbles is a 13-year-old dog and a very reactive one. Because of that, we have unfortunately experienced times where people were unsure how to approach her or didn’t always know how to care for her in the way she needed. From the moment we brought her to Arista, we felt something different. They didn’t see her as a difficult dog; they saw her as Bubbles. They were patient, understanding, professional, and incredibly compassionate. If anyone has an REACTIVE dog they know the struggle, but Arista’s team did NOT hesitate one bit to help us and Bubbles. They took the time to understand her, respected her needs, and treated her with patience, compassion, and professionalism.

When we found out she needed surgery, we were terrified. At her age, we were scared about what the outcome would be, but the entire team reassured us, answered every question we had, and gave us the confidence that she was in the best possible hands.
I want to personally thank Nikki at the front desk, Erin, Dr. Shufflebottom, Dr. Mix, Samantha, Ellie, and every single member of the Arista team who cared for Bubbles. I did my best to remember everyone’s names because every person we interacted with made an impact. From the morning crew to the night crew, everyone treated Bubbles and our family with kindness, respect, and genuine care. When we called during different times for updates the morning and night crew all knew the exact updates for Bubbles and communicated with us thoroughly!

They didn’t just take care of her medically, but they supported us emotionally too. Every concern, every question, and every moment where we needed reassurance was met with patience and compassion. That kind of kindness cannot be measured, and it is something we will never forget.

Thanks to Arista, Bubbles is doing amazing. She truly feels like a brand-new dog, and we are so thankful to have our girl feeling happy and healthy again.

I cannot recommend Arista enough. If you are looking for a veterinary team that combines skill, professionalism, empathy, and genuine love for animals, this is the place. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for taking care of Bubbles and treating her like family! ( I included some recent pictures of our girl, so the team can see how great she’s doing!)

The facility is very new and clean with a full staff of vet techs and Vet MDs during regular hours and nights and weekends for ER visits.  They have done wonders to help our little dog over the past month+ of care.

My friends took their dog here for a surgery consult a couple weeks ago after already being in and out of veterinary clinics. Dr. Mcphretridge and her nurse Iris took such good care of their sweet baby and made them feel so comfortable. I know my friend can be cautious about her baby but they were the perfect team and am so grateful they were there.
We went here tonight after our dog had a seizure. He was promptly seen and kindly cared for. Very nice to have an emergency 24 hour vet in the neighborhood!

Let me start by saying the experience at the actual hospital was wonderful. The vet was extremely caring, I know they did what they could do and we felt very at peace with How things went and how we were treated. HOWEVER the management of my cats cremation has been at this point, extremely disrespectful to my cat and myself.
It took calling twice and a follow up to finally be told that her ashes were at Cedar Hill pet cemetery. We finally went there and saw no place of any sort dedicated to this. I called and was told that no that wasn’t the right place, And they would get back to us. I was also told during this Conversation that their records show we picked up the ashes. (At this point I wish I had)
Followed up again, now told it’s not cedar hill it’s Arlington somewhere but given no info.
Then told again it’s cedar hill, but cedar hill says they don’t even handle that. I can not believe how mismanaged this is. Do other people not want to visit their pets memorial if they chose that option? How does NO ONE know where it is. It should be an extremely simple answer to a simple and important question .I am at the point that I’m hurt all over again, knowing that my pets ashes were not handled with care. I just want to be able to visit a place dedicated to her (and the other pets), and now I wish that I had gotten her ashes or a grave, but the whole process was extremely rushed and I had to make a decision on the spot. I wish yall gave people time to decide how it’s important to them to handle their pet, and for the love of God at least know where you put their ashes.

I am so thankful and pleased with the care my sweet Lila received. She was transferred to Arista, after we pulled an all nighter at VEG in Fort Worth. She was diagnosed with a Pneumothorax from blunt force trauma (kicked by a steer) and VEG ultimately could not handle how critical she had become. As soon as we walked in the door Lila was taken straight to the back to be stabilized. She was immediately assessed by the weekend ER doctors and they came to talk to me and explain everything. Being someone who has worked in vetmed the past 2 years I was extremely impressed by the professionalism and care shown to both my dog and myself. She ultimately spent the weekend in the ICU and was taken to surgery the Monday following. She is now home and recovering great! I could not be more thankful for the care from Dr. Olson, Dr. Shuffelbottom, Dr. Mix, and Dr. Rudd. And a HUGE thank you to all the technicians and assistants in the ICU and on the surgical team, I know the work that goes into caring for these cases and I know the hard work from the technicians and assistants can be overlooked. THANK YOU❤️

We took our puppy, Aster, here for a blood transfusion after the urgent care we had been referred to had run out of blood. From the moment we walked in we knew our boy was gonna be okay. The office was very neat and comfortable and we got into a room quickly. The room was also lovely, their tables fold up and down making it a lot less intimidating for the animals and for us. Tiaara and Doctor Mix quickly went over our options with us (Not making us wait to see anyone or dragging their feet on putting together an action plan) and once we had a plan they took him back. They let him keep his blanket during his transfusion which I really appreciated as it was clear they valued his comfort and happiness as much as his health. When we returned for pick up our boy had sprung to life. We could never express enough gratitude for the care our family received from Doctor Mix and Tiaara as our boy would not have lasted much longer without help and now all he wants is to play, eat, and snuggle. Thank you all so much for saving his life 🫶🏻🥰

We took our sweet Lovey for a cardiology consult. The entire staff was kind and professional. The vet tech and doctor answered all questions and were very supportive as we struggled with the very serious condition that faced Lovey. The compassionate way they interacted with us and with Lovey was remarkable. Good after visit communication and follow up as well. Highly recommend this clinic and can’t say enough about the amazing care Lovey received.

I cannot say enough good things about Arista Advanced Pet Care. After my cat, Mort, fell from three stories, I rushed him in terrified. From the moment we arrived, the team acted with urgency and compassion. I was placed in a room within a minute, and Mort was taken back for examination almost immediately.

The staff was incredibly understanding of how worried I was and took the time to answer every question I had. After his physical exam and X-rays, they reassured me that Mort appeared healthy and was okay to go home. While that was wonderful news, I was still anxious. When I brought Mort back for additional testing, they received my concerns with grace and understanding rather than dismissing them.

They ran the additional tests I requested, took excellent care of my baby, and made me feel heard throughout the entire process. What truly stood out was that they even called me two days later to check on Mort and see how his recovery was going.

During one of the most stressful experiences I've had as a pet owner, the team at Arista provided exceptional medical care, kindness, and peace of mind. I am so grateful for everyone who helped care for Mort, and I would not hesitate to recommend them to any pet parent!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!

We are so incredibly grateful to Arista Advanced Pet Care for helping save our German Shepherd, Apollo !

Going through an emergency with your dog is terrifying, and our family was very scared. From the moment we arrived, everyone at Arista treated us with kindness, compassion, and professionalism. We truly felt that they cared — not only about Apollo, but about us too.

A huge thank you to Dr. Jourdan McPhetridge for performing Apollo’s surgery and taking such great care of him. Apollo is a German Shepherd with a very strong personality and can definitely be challenging at times, but knowing he was in such caring and capable hands gave us so much comfort. We are also very thankful to Eric for taking such wonderful care of Apollo after surgery we truly appreciate all the care and patience he showed our boy.

One thing we especially appreciated was the communication. During such a stressful time, they kept us updated, answered our questions, and made us feel supported every step of the way.

Apollo is now back home and recovering well, and we are beyond thankful.
Thank you to the entire team at Arista Advanced Pet Care!

We went to Arista for the first time this evening because one of our dog’s mast cell tumors ruptured. The nurses and vet were all incredibly caring and attentive. They made sure our little girl was comfortable throughout the entire process. Strongly recommend!

These guys at this place are the best. I had an emergency during surgery at another vet, an unexpected complication.  They rushed him over to these guys. They cared for my boy 24/7! the Love their  staff gave my Rocky was unbelievable!! Thank you! He is doing amazing g thanks to these guys!

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK. 1-star reviews are the most honest. My experience here was disappointing from start to finish. The staff seemed indifferent, and the place was poorly maintained. The service I received was not as advertised, and the quality was far below expectations. I felt like no effort was made to ensure customer satisfaction. Based on what I saw, the negative reviews reflect the reality of what you can expect. I would strongly recommend avoiding this place if you value your time and money.
Outstanding care and compassion. Customer service was excellent thank you Anthony for greeting us. Dr. Hogberg we appreciate your honesty and care for our dog. Can’t wait to bring her home.

We had 2 emergency care issues with long hair large lab. March 9, 2026 and 5 weeks later.  Separate incidents. Staff is ever so kind, caring and run charges by you prior to care!  They are the best of the best!  I highly recommend them!
They explain in detail their prognosis and go over it with you.  They explain the pro's and cons, etc.  They are so caring......❤️
Thank you so much for your 5 star review, Yaneli!

Eternally grateful to all the staff at Arista who helped me when my dog smacked the side of her face on a metal stool while playing in the park behind our building, causing the area around her eye to bleed. Because my mind went to the worst places, we immediately went to Arista to rule out any dangerous problems with her eye. Everyone was efficient, kind, not judgmental, and explained things thoroughly to me. They even called me a few days later to follow up. Would highly recommend if you ever have to deal with any pet emergencies.

Also, just FYI to any readers, as I learned this from a neighbor: if your dog is sick, you want to go to an ED that has the equipment/capabilities and can contact tertiary specialists, especially when time matters. Arista is one of those vet EDs in the area so don’t waste your time elsewhere.

We took our Cavalier King Charles here after he ate our child’s shoe insole. It was super late in the night but the staff was incredibly accommodating and agile! They induced vomiting and were able to extract all the things before it was fully digested- for which we are SO grateful!!! The Dr. was super knowledgeable and helped us come up with a plan for how to prevent this from happening again. Thank you Arista for taking care of our furbaby!!

Very bad experience. We took our pet there as an emergency around 8:00 PM because he was bleeding, and we expected to receive fast, compassionate, and professional care. Unfortunately, they made us wait too long, and we did not feel that the situation was treated with the urgency it deserved.

The treatment we received was cold, lacking empathy, and made us feel very uncomfortable. Honestly, we left with the feeling that we were judged and possibly discriminated against. We don’t know if it was because we are Latino, because of our pet, or because he is not a “purebred” animal. What we do know is that during an emergency, people expect respect, guidance, and help — not indifference.

Thank God we found another place where our pet was treated with kindness, urgency, and professionalism. I would not recommend this place for veterinary emergencies, especially if you are looking for humane and compassionate care during such a stressful moment.

I can’t say enough good things about Arista Advanced Pet Care Animal Hospital. They truly saved my dog Rex’s life.
We were referred there on a Friday, and from the moment we arrived, the team immediately sprang into action. It was clear right away that Rex was in the best possible hands. The entire staff showed incredible attention, care, and compassion during one of the most stressful times I’ve ever experienced as a pet owner.
Dr. Brett is nothing short of a hero to me. Rex was genuinely at death’s door, and thanks to his expertise and the team’s quick response, my dog is alive today. This isn’t an exaggeration—it’s the truth.
What stood out just as much as the medical care was the communication. The staff patiently took my calls, provided updates, and made sure I was informed every step of the way. That level of support meant everything.
By Sunday evening, Rex was able to come home, and I am beyond grateful. Words really can’t express how thankful I am for the exceptional care they provided.
If you ever find yourself needing urgent or advanced care for your pet, I wholeheartedly recommend them.

Thanks,
Rex Mathews Family

We were referred to Arista by our vet for a growth on our dog’s toe that needed removal and could be cancerous. Our vet referred us Friday morning. I received a call from Arista the same day, and they scheduled an appt for the next morning less than 24hrs later.
We went in for the appt, and they immediately began walking us through the surgery process and all details. The staff was very friendly and gave us the space to talk it over. They ended up doing surgery the same day which is incredible! They did an excellent job keeping us updated - calling us right before 1-2 times, right after, and again as she was recovering.
They called 1-2 days later to check in on how Kiwi was recovering.
Additionally, they called us 1 week later (Sat) to give us the results of the biopsy instead of waiting for Monday and/or our doctor to be in office which was very kind because who wants to wait longer for test results.
Overall, I really couldn’t be happier with Arista, Dr. Skerrett, Spencer, and the whole team. Very thankful for their care of our pup!

I have been in twice for my older standard poodle. The first time was with the cardiologist to further diagnose a faint heart murmur and the second was more of an emergency with a gastro upset. Both times was a great experience, both with the staff and with the very thorough and knowledgeable doctors

We made a 5 hour drive to Arista Advanced Pet Care with our male husky, Havoc, hoping to finally get answers and help for him and this team exceeded every expectation we had.

From the very beginning, they treated us and our boy with genuine compassion, patience, and dedication. This hasn’t been a simple or quick journey, but what truly stood out is that they never gave up on Havoc. They remained committed every step of the way, continuously working to figure out what was going on and how to help him.

Their communication has been exceptional. They made themselves available for calls with the doctor whenever we needed, kept us informed throughout the process, and always made us feel heard and supported. One of the most meaningful parts of our experience was being able to visit Havoc anytime, we never felt separated or out of the loop.

It’s rare to find a team that combines such high-level medical care with this level of empathy and kindness. They didn’t just treat our dog, they cared for our entire family during a very stressful time.

We are beyond grateful for everything they’ve done. We highly recommend Arista Advanced Pet Care to anyone looking for a team that truly cares. We will forever be loyal clients and thankful for this incredible group of people.
Do NOT recommend. Waited multiple hours before being seen. Very $$, no care for you. Had to pester the doctor to call me back about test results for multiple days.

After a full month of my dog being sick and receiving the same diagnosis from two different veterinarians, we were unable to get his condition under control. Feeling discouraged and having already incurred significant expenses, I decided to seek a third opinion and took a chance on Arista, and it turned out to be the best decision I could have made.

Dr. Adamson provided a completely new diagnosis that ultimately led to my dog’s recovery. She took the time to thoroughly investigate the root cause of his condition and demonstrated exceptional care, compassion, and attention to detail throughout the process.

What truly set this experience apart was the follow-up. After our visit, both Dr. Adamson and her staff continued to check on my dog through calls and emails for several days, ensuring he was improving and that we had everything we needed.

I am incredibly grateful for the level of care we received and truly believe we were meant to find them. I cannot recommend Arista and Dr. Adamson highly enough.

My dog Mars was a patient here back in December, but I'm just now getting around to posting a review to let everyone know how amazing Arista was. He was there for 4 nights and they took such amazing care of him and kept me updated the whole time. Dr. Mix and all the staff were so understanding and compassionate. I could tell they really cared about Mars.

We had to put him to sleep due to his severity, but the entire process was handled with grace and empathy and I'm grateful for them helping me through one of my worst days. Faithful pet cremation is the company they use, and they were also incredible. I got his ashes delivered to me within a day or two and the paw print was perfect- they put great detail and care into what they do as well.

Thank you all again- Mars was surrounded by love in his final days!

I truly cannot say enough incredible things about this hospital and the entire team.

Over the past few months, they have helped us through some of the scariest moments of our lives with our dog, Beans. What started as swollen leg turned into a serious infection quickly. It all felt overwhelming and uncertain, but from day one, we felt supported, heard, and genuinely cared for.

Dr. Hogberg went above and beyond in a way I will never forget. He worked tirelessly to get us multiple surgical referrals and made sure we had every option available. Because of his efforts, we were able to stabilize our dog and ultimately have surgery at the hospital with Dr. McPhetridge, who did an absolutely incredible job. We are so grateful for the outcome and the level of care both provided.

Not long after, we were back again for a completely unrelated and equally terrifying neurological episode. Dr. Peoples stepped in during that moment and was not only knowledgeable, but incredibly compassionate. She took the time to reach out to her network and connect us with the right people. She truly made me feel less alone during a very emotional and uncertain time.

Beyond the doctors, the entire staff is exceptional. The front desk team and vet techs are truly amazing. They remembered our dog, welcomed him with so much warmth, and treated him with such genuine love and care during multiple overnight stays. That kind of consistency and kindness means more than I can put into words when you’re going through something like this.

And on top of everything, their pricing has been incredibly reasonable for the level of care and expertise provided, which is something that does not go unnoticed.

This hospital didn’t just treat Beans. They supported us through some of our hardest days. We are endlessly grateful to this entire team and would recommend them to anyone without hesitation.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE UNLESS YOU WANT THEM TO KILL YOUR FURR BABY!

This place needs to be investigated and shut down ASAP!!!!!!

After 4 hours in that horrific place and $1,000 bill, we left with my sweet kitten in the same condition as we brought her…. Dehydrated, stomach blockage, and new knowledge of her heart rate being 120 instead of the normal 160-200 range. I have her blood work and clearly her white blood cell count is low and blood chem panel highly irregular with sodium being off the charts!

And instead of asking if we want an ultrasound which is what the radiologist recommended… they offered to CUT HER OPEN AND EXPLORE HER ABDOMEN!

They don’t care about your fur baby…. They just want your money at the cost of your pets life.

And if you scroll enough through other “great reviews” you will see reviews with similar stories. Update 01/29/26: After the post below and a call to Arista, I'm moving my previous rating from a 1 to a 3.  The ER doc called me personally and instead of making excuses, owned the facility's and his error and explained the new process they were putting in place to insure what happened below doesn't happen again.

It is incredibly rare that I give a 1 star review but as a physician, this facility needs a serious internal assessment of their reporting and quality control. I brought out sweet, yellow lab, Kora in on Thurs with a 10 month history of chronic diarrhea (multiple previous vet visits, labs, stool samples, etc.) Our regular vet finally said after our 4th diet change, "you need an internal medicine vet and an ultrasound."  She had stopped eating the day before.
Arista did an ultrasound and drew some additional labs, full chemistry and a CBC. The ER doc came to talk to me after the ultrasound and said she had an enlarged spleen and discharged us home with follow up the following Thurs and that someone would follow up with me about the labs.  No call Fri. No call Sat. Our dog was still not eating though she was drinking and peeing. I called Sat and they said as long as she's drinking and peeing, no issues. Sun I called again and said, "look, I'm a doctor, just send me the labs." They said, "sure we'll send you the labs and someone will call you to go over them." 40 mins later, I got the labs and she had a rip roaring WBC of 50 and her platelets were only 37 (meaning if she sneezed wrong she could bleed into her brain.) I never got a return call to go over the labs from Arista. I rushed her to VEG ER on 75 Central where they drew more labs. Her WBC had risen to 75, her platelets had dropped to 17 and now she was in renal failure. We requested the ultrasound from Arista be emailed to VEG and the ultrasound from Arista said her spleen was normal. Repeat ultrasound showed a massive spleen like the ER doc at Arista had said but was documented incorrectly in the ultrasound report.
I'll make the rest of this short. Tons of more labs, meds, antibiotics, IV fluids but ultimately after $8,500 and 3 nights in the hospital, we put her down yesterday because she had gone into multi organ system failure.
Critical labs need to be flagged immediately...not three days later with the patient's owner being the one to make the assessment on next steps!
Imaging reports need to be proofread and correctly reported.
There's really no oversight agency for Veterinary facilities like there are for human hospitals so hopefully, the leadership of Arista will read this and instead of getting defensive will say, "OH CRAP, we've got serious issues internally that we need to address immediately with revised systems, policies and procedures."
RIP Kora...you were the sweetest dog! 😭
